integrity: Self-contained proof and a reproducible exhaustive-and-random verification program. Computation corroborates but does not replace the infinite-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty relations; synchronous right-Euclidean completion only. The Boman catalogue was inspectable only at abstract level; independent historical-priority validation has not occurred.
title: Sharp parallel stabilization of right-Euclidean closure on finite frames
